Further there was jealousy at work place as some of male employees would not like to see success of defendant and some of them were harassing her through sexually perverted behavior.
Despite complaining with regard to specific such instances, plaintiff failed to protect honour of defendant, when she was working with them.

The defendants silently suffered discrimination at work place on the basis of gender and some of employees of plaintiff were indulged in floating rumors about defendant and thereby isolated her in the office.
The plaintiff were threatening defendant in intimidating language and was trying to remove her from responsibilities without sufficient reason.

Subsequently due to her erratic behavior, complaint was filed against her and charge sheet was also issued by plaintiff company.

It is also crystal clear that in view such disturbing situations, plaintiff company though undertook her performance improvement programme, same did not yield any result and ultimately defendant herself resigned plaintiff company.

Further though defendant denies her misbehavior and erratic attitude towards other employees of plaintiff company, Ex.P.7 certified copy of judgment in O.S.No.7704/2014 is sufficient to believe that injunction was issued against her from trespassing the premises of the plaintiff company and from posting defamatory statements in social media platform against plaintiff and its employees.

Though defendant has claimed that the said decree is obtained by plaintiff by suppressing material facts, Ex.P7 shows that she has not chosen to contest the said suit despite service of summons and till today she has not produced anything to show that she has challenged the said decree.

This aspect is sufficient to prove her initial acts alleged against defendant with regard to illegal trespass into the premises of the plaintiff and posting of defamatory articles against plaintiff and its employees in social medial platforms.

23. On perusal of defence of defendant, it shows that she has alleged that plaintiff company has failed to take necessary steps as per guidelines of Vishaka case by forming necessary committee against harassment faced by her during her employment in plaintiff company.
She asserts that the duty was cast upon plaintiff to protect dignity of woman employees, but it has turned blind eye to unwelcome behaviour of some of male employees, which was unbearable.

She has further alleged Nokia Solution And Network India ... vs Anagha Sonde on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75097772/

sentences.text: that conduct of plaintiff company was having effect of unreasonably interfering with defendants work performance and it created intimidating, hostile and offensive working environment.

However, during her elaborate cross examination of PW 1, no where it is suggested to him that defendant faced such harassment from particular employee nor she has admitted so called harassment from Arjun.P. Kamath who was former employee of plaintiff company.

She has specifically denied in last sentence of her cross examination dated 26.08.2023 that she had no such relationship with said Arjun.P.Kamath and it shows that she has made such allegations against other employees of plaintiff company in vague manner.
Under such circumstances, in the absence of sufficient and cogent materials, it is difficult to believe that defendant had undergone any such harassments during her employment in plaintiff company.

Further absolutely no documents are produced by defendant to show that she had initiated any action or filed any complaint before a committee of plaintiff company for Prevention of sexual harassment against women at workplace constituted as per guidelines of Visaka's case and non formation of such committee by plaintiff company.
Further if she had made such complaint and no such action was taken by such committee of plaintiff company, she had alternative remedy to approach concerned forum.
No such action appears to have been initiated by defendant.
On the other hand in para 28 of her written statement defendant admits that due to mental depression, she could not memorize what are all she has done and with whom she had communicated.

24. Further on summarizing the entire averments of written statement of defendant, it shows that she had indirectly justified the alleged action against plaintiff for not taking action against sexual harassment on one side and on other side she pleads her ignorance about such acts by taking defence of her mental depression.
Further she has stated that the alleged e-mails are created and fabricated by plaintiff company himself.
However as per Ex.P.6, it is alleged that such e-mails were sent by her through her e-mail by name anagha.sonde@gmail.com.
During cross-examination DW.1 on confrontation of her profile of facebook, she has admitted the same and same is marked as per Ex.P.13.
In said document the aforesaid e-mail by name anagha.sonde@gmail.com is shown as one of her primary e-mail used for advertising her life coach profession.
It further shows that she has mentioned http://www.thenirvanagroup.in/, to which the derogatory email is sent as per Ex.P6 email document.
This aspect is sufficient believe that the aforesaid derogatory e-mails have been forwarded by defendant herself.

Further though defendant has vaguely denied forwarding of such e-mails, she has not produced anything to show that said e-mails or email group does not belong to her or same has been hacked by somebody else.

The Ex. P 13 and 14 documents are sufficient to hold that defendant herself has forwarded the above offending e-mails to plaintiff and its employees,
which has resulted into disruptive atmosphere within said company.

25. For these reasons, it is incumbent upon this Court to hold that plaintiff has sufficiently proved that defendant being it's former employee has sent aforesaid defamatory and derogatory emails to it's employees without any rights whatsoever and her such acts have resulted into nuisance and harassment to plaintiff and it's employees.
Hence Issue No.1 and 2 are answered in the Affirmative.

26. ISSUE NO.3 :- The plaintiff has sufficiently proved that defendant being it's former employee has sent aforesaid defamatory and derogatory emails to it's employees without any rights whatsoever and her such acts have resulted into nuisance and harassment to plaintiff and it's Nokia Solution And Network India ... vs Anagha Sonde on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75097772/

sentences.text: On the other hand defendant has failed to prove that the alleged emails are fabricated by plaintiff or to justify her alleged acts in sending such derogatory email to the employees of the plaintiff.

27. Further counsel for defendant has taken specific contention that admittedly previous suit in O.S.No.7704/2014 was filed by plaintiff for similar relief and same has been decreed in favour of plaintiff as per Ex.P7 copy of Judgment and as such present suit for same relief is barred by principles of res-judicata as per section 11 of C.P.C.

The relevant portion of said section is culled out as under :-
Section 11 of C.P.C. Res judicata :-
No Court shall try any suit or issue in which the matter directly and substantially in issue has been directly and substantially in issue in a former suit between the same parties, or between parties under whom they or any of them claim, litigating under the same title, in a Court competent to try such subsequent suit or the suit in which such issue has been subsequently raised, and has been heard and finally decided by such Court.
28.

However on perusal of Ex.P7 certified copy of Judgment in O.S.No. 7704/2014, it shows that plaintiff has filed said suit against defendant seeking to restrain her from trespassing it's schedule premises and from restraining her from posting derogatory comments on her facebook page.

However present suit is filed seeking relief of prohibitory injunction against defendant by restraining her from defaming,
harassing, threatening, stalking through persons or through any electronic or social media any employee or person attached to plaintiff and from restraining her from sending any communication by e- mail, post or through any other media to any employee or person attached to the plaintiff.
Further plaintiff has narrated complete new and different cause of action for present suit and produced documents to prove the same.
Hence relief claimed and cause of action in O.S.No.7704/2014 and present suit are not similar.

Hence absolutely there is no reasons to believe that the matter in issue of this suit has been directly and substantially in issue in a former suit i.e. in O.S.No.7704/2014 as per Section 11 of C.P.C.
Hence absolutely there is no reason to believe that suit is hit by section 11 of C.P.C.

On the other hand plaintiff by adducing cogent oral and documentary evidence has sufficiently proved alleged nuisance and harassment caused by defendant by sending aforesaid derogatory emails to it's employees and as such it is definitely entitled for relief sought in the suit.
Hence Issue No.3 is answered in the Affirmative.

On same day her parents were called to the office of plaintiff and they admitted her in psychiatric division of a Bengaluru Baptist Hospital.
